# Week

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A seven-day time period grouping consecutive days.

## Scope note

Contains Days via IN_WEEK: parent time horizon for weekly planning, log, journal, and review artifacts.

- [Calendar](../Calendar/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
